categories.runtime: Required for production API and WebUI operation
categories.optional_runtime: Required only when optional feature is enabled (e.g. polish model)
categories.evaluation: Used only in benchmark/evaluation scripts, not shipped in Docker image
categories.dev: Development/testing only, not in Docker image
categories.training: Offline fine-tuning only, not in Docker image

dependencies.name: torch

dependencies.redistribution: Permitted with notice; binary wheels include CUDA runtime
dependencies.notes: Dockerfile pins CPU-only wheel via --index-url; installed env has CUDA build. Docker image uses CPU-only.
